title: Kenyan Chicken Wrap
description: A flavorful and healthy wrap filled with marinated chicken, herbs, and Kenyan spices.

ingredients.name: kenyan mix of herbs
ingredients.notes: such as thyme, rosemary, and oregano

instructions: Marinate the chicken in herbal tea, kenyan mix of herbs, and healing turmeric for at least 30 minutes.
Grill or bake the chicken until cooked through, reaching a safe internal temperature of 165°F.
Warm the whole wheat wrap in the oven or in a dry pan.
Assemble the wrap by spreading the wrap sauce on the wrap, followed by sliced grilled chicken, chopped cilantro, and any other desired toppings.
